decisions.statement: A color is named by the palette name in the path.
The color id is that name under one fixed prefix.
A turn, a subagent and a stopped seat are read out of a path the same way.
Every color id this answers is one the editor's manifest contributes.
A color the manifest contributes is the hex the palette answers that name with.
A name the palette does not have is drawn in no color.
Children are tallied by the color each one carries.
A tally counts the children a row has directly rather than every one beneath it.
A child carrying no color is counted by no tally.
A color no child carries has no tally rather than a tally of none.
The tallies come back in the order the palette states its names.
A state of `unknown` is said as nothing.
A state with something waited on is said as the state and that thing.
Nothing here has the color values.

definition: the color a turn path is drawn in and the sentence a turn state reads as
